scope: Local signed API and scripted interpretation; actual production Compose service, native table readers and released fold-0 inference. No live external model, external API or GUI claim.

native_lifecycle.projection_source: tools/compose_runner_events.sh at source_revision; fixed child_started/child_retired fields from bounded Docker logs, not a lifecycle authority
native_lifecycle.retirement_scope: Both scientific replies preceded owner-session closure and child retirement. Return code -15 is not a failed prediction or a normal child exit.
native_lifecycle.after_down_up_repeated_up_down: Same three native container IDs and byte-identical projected child events; no third native operation. All seven containers stopped; their bounded Docker logs retained.

science.input: Existing fixed chloromethane nm table, supplied independently to two distinct Jobs/Attempts; no new expected predictions
science.checks: Existing independent binary64 nm-to-angstrom error bound, supplied atom order, exact H/C output population and finite shifts. This successive-service witness does not add an accuracy claim.
